title: The right adjoint for an open immersion
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, including the
finite coefficient rings
$A_{E,n}$,
and let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be a
open immersion.
On the small pro-etale sites,
extension by zero has the
inverse image as its
right adjoint on the entire ordinary derived categories:

$$
j_!:D(U_{\mathrm{proet}},A)\rightleftarrows
D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A):j^*.
$$

In particular, the right adjoint is constructed without a constructibility
or finite-Tor hypothesis.

proof.text: By [lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization](1)-(3), $U_{\mathrm{proet}}$ is the open slice site and $A_U$ is the restricted coefficient ring. For finite commutative $A$, [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map] identifies the specified coefficient sheaves with the constant ring sheaves and their canonical map $j^{-1}A_X\to A_U$ is an isomorphism. Apply [lem-pur-proetale-open-unit-evaluation] to identify the actual module pullback $j^*$ with restriction: its isomorphisms $(j^*N)(V\to U)\cong N(V\to X)$ are natural in $N,V$ and linear for that constant-coefficient identification. Put $F=j_!$, $G=j^*$. The natural Hom bijections of [lem-weil-extension-by-zero-adjunction] give $F\dashv G$. Exactness of $F$ is [lem-weil-extension-by-zero-exact]; exact additive module inverse image with this coefficient isomorphism is [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-immersion-limit-preservation]. Thus these are exact adjoint functors between the full constant-$A$ module-sheaf categories. In particular $F$ is additive: an exact functor between abelian categories preserves the finite biproduct diagrams defining addition.

source.place: Tags 03DI (lemma-extension-by-zero) and 03DJ (lemma-extension-by-zero-exact), applied to the proetale localized site of proetale.tex Tag 09AE (definition-extension-zero); the immersion inverse-image tool extends the closed-immersion result of Tag 09AA by open slice restriction.

proof.text: Apply $F,G$ termwise to all cochain complexes. By [lem-weil-pbc-termwise-adjunction-homotopy](a), the termwise functors $C(F),C(G)$ are adjoint with the degreewise unit and counit. By [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization], they preserve quasi-isomorphisms and induce functors $\overline F,\overline G$ with comparisons $p:\overline FQ_U\cong Q_XC(F)$ and $q:\overline GQ_X\cong Q_UC(G)$. Apply [lem-sfb-adjunction-localization] to the categories of complexes, their quasi-isomorphisms, the localization functors $Q_U,Q_X$ and these comparisons. It descends the termwise unit and counit, with both triangle identities, to give $\overline F\dashv\overline G$ on the full ordinary unbounded derived categories.

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-functor](1), $\overline F$ and $\overline G$ are respectively the left derived extension by zero and the derived exact module inverse image. With $R_X=A_X$, $R_U=A_U$ and the canonical coefficient identification from step 1, [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] defines $Lj^*$ by precisely this termwise exact module pullback. Hence the adjunction of step 2 is the stated $j_!\dashv j^*$ on the entire ordinary derived categories. All constructions used every complex, so no constructibility or finite-Tor restriction occurs.
